in_sanskrit.name: Iyliya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon goddess
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Iyliya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Iyliya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ila', which refers to the goddess of the moon and motherhood. Iyliya is believed to bring blessings of fertility, nurturing, and protection.
